digest.component_or_area: tests/interfaces test infrastructure and rebar_repo fixture
propositions: Fixture setup consumes 47% of tests/interfaces tier wall-clock (306ms per test, 589 consumers) due to function-scoped rebar_repo running mkdir, git init, git config, init_repo, and git commit per test across 58 git process spawns.

Session-scoped template with shutil.copytree(symlinks=True) per test reduces overhead from 306ms to 22.3ms but requires four shared-state fix-ups: worktree pointers (.git and gitdir absolute paths), gate snapshot store SHA keying, environment identity (.env-id and .signing-key), and module-global _pending_cache.

Bare git worktree repair is silent no-op (validates by path existence, leaving copy on template object store) and a tier-wide autouse guard must reject copies by git worktree list --porcelain path resolution, not --git-common-dir.

Template fixture must build in isolated MonkeyPatch context (REBAR_ROOT, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, deleted REBAR_TRACKER_DIR/REBAR_TRACKER_BRANCH/REBAR_CONFIG) to prevent autouse environment contamination from first requester under --dist worksteal.

Sentinel tests must prove half-fixed copy (only .tickets-tracker/.git rewritten), bare git worktree repair, template path leakage in files, and re-randomization of .env-id and .signing-key are all rejected or enforced.
